title: Move to the published quest/lore 0.12.0 pair
description: Move the repository from the published quest/lore 0.11.0 pair to 0.12.0. The estate audit reading origin/dev still finds 0.11.0 in two places: the managed Quest block in CLAUDE.md declares Quest CLI 0.11.0, and .github/workflows/ci.yml pins LORE_VERSION=0.11.0. Regenerate the managed Quest block with the installed 0.12.0 CLI (routine managed-block carve-out), bump the lore pin in CI, keep the lore agent bridge current, land via a pull request with the required checks green, then promote dev to main. Requested by the orchestrator, OPAG-967, cross-session message 2026-09-30.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The managed Quest block in CLAUDE.md declares Quest CLI 0.12.0, and quest agents --check --require-installed --target claude reports current in the Tracker integrity job on the PR head SHA.
The Docs job on the PR head SHA resolves lore 0.12.0 (log line Resolved lore version: 0.12.0), with lore agents --check, lore validate --strict and lore check --strict all green in that job.
The required contexts (Docs, Tracker integrity, Check) are all green on the PR head SHA.

plan: 2. Regenerate the managed Quest block with quest agents --update-instructions --target claude and bump LORE_VERSION in ci.yml to 0.12.0.

4. With the required contexts green on the head SHA, check the acceptance criteria against that run, close GCLI-7 in the PR, and squash-merge.
5. Clean up the local branch, promote dev to main, read the refs back, and report to the orchestrator.

finalSummary: Move glyph-cli from the quest/lore 0.11.0 pair to 0.12.0. Changed: the managed Quest block in CLAUDE.md (regenerated with quest agents --update-instructions --target claude; the declared version line is the only byte the regeneration moved), .github/workflows/ci.yml (LORE_VERSION 0.11.0 -> 0.12.0, the only CI pin either tool carries, since the Tracker integrity job derives the quest version from the managed block rather than pinning it twice), and this task record. Verified on PR opum-ai/glyph-cli#27, run 36792591312 on commit 4994f1b: Tracker integrity declared and resolved quest 0.12.0 with the block current; Docs resolved lore 0.12.0 with validate --strict and check --strict at 0 errors and lore agents --check up-to-date; all three required contexts (Docs, Tracker integrity, Check) green. Local smoke: bun run check green, 19 tests (bun 1.3.14 locally; the CI Check job is the authoritative toolchain run). Addendum from the orchestrator, OPAG-967: the lore 0.12.0 agent-profile-capacity warning (lore-cli DEC-11) does not fire in this repository - the Docs job reports "Agent profiles: 4 read, 0 over capacity" under lore 0.12.0, so no profile max_tokens was changed and no sources were narrowed. Two by: lore/0.11.0 lines remain under generated in docs/ frontmatter: provenance records of the lore version that generated each file, not pins, and both strict docs gates are green with them unchanged.
